3.2.1: 💥 **Crash Reporting:** Agar app crash ho jaye, to poori details (app version, tab/function, error, last 30 log lines) automatically server par bheji jati hain — admin panel ke naye Crashes tab me dikhti hain, filters + CSV export ke saath. Ab koi bhi error chhupa nahi rahega.

📋 **Better Error Logs:** Admin Activity page ke error logs me ab full context (version, tab, function, time) + export — error report dekhkar turant samajh aata hai kya problem hai aur kaise fix kare.

📅 **Smart File Names:** Export hone wali har report ke naam me ab date & time (e.g. ABPS_Verify_20260807_143055.xlsx) — din me kitni baar bhi export karo, file overwrite nahi hogi aur rename nahi karni padegi.
